The wardrobe

Our story

Tradition, innovation, and the life of cloth.

iswas values tradition and innovation. We take a slow-fashion approach, working closely with materials to create beautiful, individual garments and objects.

Each piece begins with fabric, surface and construction. The aim is clothing that honours the past while remaining open to the future.
